state: prospective documentation-only protocol; source implementation, corpus access, Torch import, model construction, fitting, inference, simulator execution, fresh-scene generation, and held-out access are not authorized
question: Under one deterministic matched-compute training clock on the unchanged ORIGINAL topology, does the fixed advice-augmented corpus meet the unchanged fresh-scene simulator capability gates?

single_intervention.name: matched training-and-selection clock
single_intervention.replaces: Twenty arm-local epochs, which yielded 42,340 versus 143,940 real row presentations and 1,440 versus 4,720 optimizer updates.
single_intervention.with: Exactly 46,080 real loss-bearing row presentations and 1,440 optimizer updates for every old-corpus and augmented model, followed by selection of the terminal update-1,440 checkpoint.
single_intervention.reason: The completed checkpoint-support audit found that corpus composition, row exposure, update count, source order, and selected effective budget changed jointly in v2. This study replaces the epoch and arm-local checkpoint-selection clocks together with one matched training-and-selection clock. Data arms, topology, model, loss, optimizer, learning rate, seeds, runtime, and capability thresholds remain unchanged.
single_intervention.causal_limit: The intervention is the complete matched training-and-selection clock, including row/update budget, deterministic tail handling, and terminal selection. The study cannot separately attribute an outcome to update count, row count, terminal selection, advice correctness, source composition, or source order.

evidence_basis.preservation: All v2 plans, failures, checkpoints, reports, raw evidence, and compact audit outputs remain immutable. V3 writes only to fresh outputs and never relabels or replaces v2 evidence.

corpora.identity_rule: The data-manifest hash binds every ordered run_id, episode, row count, feature_target_sha256, label, split, source path, and raw-source inventory. A source identity is the exact UTF-8 string run_id + ':' + decimal episode + ':' + lowercase feature_target_sha256 from that manifest.

augmented.prefix: Entries 0 through 9 equal /arms/old/train byte-for-byte and in the same order.
augmented.targets: old prefix unchanged executed targets; advice suffix exact recorded float32 nav_advice_action

recorded_development.manifest_pointer: /arms/old/dev and /arms/augmented/dev, which must be exactly equal
recorded_development.use: One terminal recorded-input imitation evaluation per model after the update-1,440 checkpoint has already been selected. It cannot select a checkpoint or qualify capability.

matched_budget.budget_anchor: 1,440 is the completed v2 old-corpus full-fit update count. It is predeclared once; no alternate budget is tried after results.

sampler.definition_of_presentation: One admitted, finite corpus row is passed through the model and contributes exactly once to the update loss. Reuse in a declared later sweep is another presentation. Padding, masked filler, synthetic rows, and rows that do not contribute loss are never presentations.

full_sweeps_and_remainder.formula: For total R=46,080 and corpus size N, q,r=divmod(R,N). Emit q complete sweeps, then an exact r-row remainder sweep.

remainder_allocation.formula: For source length n_i, start with floor(r*n_i/N). Give the remaining rows, one each, to sources in descending order of integer remainder (r*n_i) mod N, breaking ties by lower manifest index. The exact allocations must equal the arrays below.

remainder_start.input_bytes: UTF-8('M7-NAV-V3-MATCHED-BUDGET-1') + NUL + ASCII decimal training seed + NUL + UTF-8 source identity
remainder_start.formula: Interpret the first eight SHA-256 digest bytes as one unsigned big-endian integer and take modulo source length. Arm is intentionally absent, so a shared old source has the same seed-specific start in both arms.
remainder_start.selection: Present the allocated number of consecutive real rows from that start, wrapping at most once. Split at a wrap and reset hidden before row zero; never create last-row-to-first-row recurrence.

sampler.order: For every complete sweep, visit sources in exact manifest order and rows in increasing tick order. Then visit remainder sources in exact manifest order using their seed-specific segments. No shuffle or interleaving across sources.
sampler.coverage: Within each arm and seed, every eligible source row appears exactly q or q+1 times. The implementation publishes the source identity, length, q, remainder allocation, start, fragment ranges, presentation count, and schedule SHA-256 before fitting.
sampler.tail_policy: Every real source tail is loss-bearing. No row is dropped because it is shorter than 32; no padding, zero row, repeated filler, cross-source hidden carry, or fractional update is allowed.
sampler.packing: Concatenate the declared source fragments only for accounting. Pack them into exactly 1,440 update units of exactly 32 real rows. If one update contains several fragments, forward them separately with their own hidden-state boundary, sum all 32 per-row losses, divide by 32, call backward once, clip once, and step once.
sampler.hidden_state: Reset to exact model.reset() at every source start, full-sweep restart, remainder-segment start, and remainder wrap. Carry hidden through contiguous rows of the same fragment. At each optimizer boundary detach the continuing hidden exactly once. Never carry hidden across sources or a wrap.

training.paired_initialization: Separately fresh models use the same declared seed and exact ORIGINAL graph within each pair. No learned initialization, rewire call, topology screen, seed selection, or checkpoint reuse.

numerics.loss: mean(0.5*((velocity_error/3)^2 + 1 - cos(heading_error_radians))) over exactly 32 real rows per optimizer update
numerics.trainable_parameter_roster: exact unchanged male_model.make_model ORIGINAL-graph roster; all fixed graph weights and integer buffers remain frozen

selected_checkpoint.rule: The only admissible checkpoint is the state immediately after successful optimizer update 1,440. No intermediate best-loss, arm-specific, seed-winning, rescue, averaged, or post-development checkpoint selection is allowed.
selected_checkpoint.recorded_dev_timing: Evaluate the unchanged four-source recorded-development split once after the terminal weights have already been copied for publication; its loss cannot alter selection.
selected_checkpoint.recorded_dev_sequence: Zero hidden at each source; contiguous 32-row windows carry hidden; final partial windows are real and loss-bearing; no padding or cross-source carry.
selected_checkpoint.reason: A terminal-only rule keeps full and selected effective budgets exactly matched. The departure from v2 earliest-minimum selection is inseparable from this budget-control intervention and limits causal granularity.

behavior_source_admission.future_freeze: Before any corpus path is opened or Torch imported, a separately reviewed execution manifest must bind every new v3 source/test/launcher byte, every transitive local behavior source, the protocol bytes, exact argv/environment/cwd/output, and all immutable input hashes. Recheck the same roster immediately before publication.
behavior_source_admission.lazy_boundary: Importing the planned sampler and trainer for pure admission must leave Torch and MuJoCo absent from sys.modules. Held-out paths and scene IDs are not accepted by the training CLI.

development.reservation_check: These IDs do not occur in the committed plan/report/manifest rosters at base a875024. Before generation, a frozen source-only admission must scan every retained raw scene registry and manifest plus every prior branch, worktree, and evidence root; it must repeat exact ID-roster disjointness and later reject canonical scene, scientific-initial, and complete-payload duplicates against every prior train/development/evaluation scene and held-out 3120-3127. Seed disjointness and the base-text scan alone are insufficient.
development.case_order: scene increasing; training seed 10,11,12; old-corpus then augmented
development.gate: All 24 owners must be normal and admitted, and each augmented training seed independently must reach unchanged native last_outcome.reason == 'goal' within 600 ticks on at least 3 of 4 scenes.
development.failure: Any augmented seed below 3/4, any incomplete owner, or any infrastructure/admission failure permanently keeps held-out locked for this protocol.

held_out.state: reserved, locked, and unopened by this planning slice
held_out.separate_go: A passed development gate is necessary but does not authorize held-out. A new held-out execution manifest, independent source/evidence review, resource admission, and explicit separate GO are required before generating or opening any held-out geometry or payload.
held_out.case_order: scene increasing; training seed 10,11,12; old-corpus then augmented
held_out.gate: All 48 owners must be normal and admitted, and each augmented training seed independently must reach goal within 600 ticks on at least 6 of 8 scenes.

fresh_evaluation.episode: Fresh zero-hidden, teacher-free episode; one checkpoint inference per interval; unmasked eyes; no teacher query, privileged input, action override, reset, intervention, rescue, retry, or replacement scene.
fresh_evaluation.reporting: Report every natural outcome, old-arm counts, augmented counts, and paired per-scene differences. Never pool seeds, choose a winning seed, invent a comparative threshold, or tune from development/held-out outcomes.

estimands.capability: Primary: whether the fixed augmented-corpus ORIGINAL-topology training procedure at the matched budget clears the absolute per-seed fresh-development and, only later, held-out gates. The old-corpus arm is a paired descriptive comparator under the same budget.
estimands.data_contrast: Secondary descriptive contrast: old corpus versus the exact fixed advice-augmented corpus under matched update and presentation budgets. It is the effect of the complete procedures, not a decomposition of label, coverage, order, or optimizer mechanisms.
estimands.topology: Excluded. No degree-rewired graph, graph choice, topology control, or topology claim appears in training or evaluation. Any topology estimand requires a separate prospective study after this capability lane.
unsupported: causal mechanism within the matched-budget intervention

attempts_and_resources.source_phase: Synthetic tests may be rerun before source freeze. No numerical or retained-input access is allowed in the source phase.

training.attempt: One enclosing study attempt. Each seed pair may start once in fixed order; any failed/crashed/timed-out pair is retained and forbids retry, while later pairs remain not_started.

development.attempt: Exactly one stage invocation and at most one owner execution per fixed case; no retry or replacement.
development.time_basis: The internal cap equals 24 owners times the full 180-second owner maximum; the 50/60-second margins cover normal publication and the enclosing hard target.

held_out.attempt: Exactly one later stage invocation after separate GO and at most one owner execution per fixed case; no retry or replacement.
held_out.time_basis: The internal cap equals 48 owners times the full 180-second owner maximum; the 50/60-second margins cover normal publication and the enclosing hard target.

attempts_and_resources.work_estimate: Training comprises 276,480 real row presentations, 8,640 optimizer updates, and 7,368 terminal recorded-dev rows. This is 49.5 percent of v2 training presentations and 46.8 percent of v2 updates. Historical v2 used about 140 seconds per pair under the same host/runtime, so 4 to 8 minutes for all three v3 pairs including admission/publication is a planning estimate, not a promise; hard bounds above govern.

tests_before_execution_freeze: Pure schedule fixture on the exact 10- and 22-source length arrays proves 46,080 real rows, 1,440 updates, 32 rows per update, exact Hamilton allocations, exact published per-source totals, q-or-q+1 row exposure, deterministic hash starts, no padding, no drop, and byte-identical replay.
Synthetic short-source, 31/32/33-row, multi-fragment update, remainder-wrap, Hamilton-tie, and source-boundary fixtures prove reset/carry/detach and loss-denominator semantics without Torch.

A mocked numerical boundary proves one zero_grad/backward/clip/step per 32 real rows, separate forward calls at fragment boundaries, no cross-source hidden carry, and exactly terminal update 1,440 publication.

Admission fixtures reject corpus count/order/identity drift, altered source lengths, old-prefix mismatch, advice-label mismatch, graph/cell/runtime/source drift, nonfinite arrays/loss/parameters, schedule hash mismatch, output overlap, stale output, insufficient storage, deadline/RSS/output overflow, and any held-out argument before Torch import.

Publication fault injection proves durable attempt reservation precedes input/Torch work; crash, timeout, fsync, rename, and final-source failures retain one failure receipt, never publish admissible success, and permanently consume the attempt.
Selection fixtures prove only update 1,440 is publishable and recorded-dev loss cannot change the selected checkpoint.

Development source fixtures prove exact 3130-3133 case order, all-six scientific-initial matching, prior/held-out seed and payload disjointness, unchanged native goal scoring, 3/4 per-seed reduction, all-owner admission, and held-out lock on every negative or operational failure.
Fresh-process imports prove no Torch or MuJoCo in pure admission/schedule tests and no held-out path is opened by training or development preparation.
execution_stops: Do not implement from an unreviewed or changed protocol. Source implementation ends with a new hash-bound execution manifest and independent review before any retained input or Torch access.
Create and fsync a fresh durable attempt reservation before any corpus/checkpoint/model/Torch operation; output existence consumes the attempt after crash or outer timeout.

Before fitting, stop on any path, byte count, hash, source roster/order/length, schedule, runtime, graph, model, output freshness, storage, RSS, or deadline mismatch. Do not substitute, filter, regenerate, or retry.

During fitting, stop the study on the first wrong update/presentation/fragment/reset count, nonfinite value, parameter-roster change, source drift, timeout, RSS breach, or output-cap breach. Preserve completed earlier pairs and mark later pairs not_started.
No development owner starts until all six terminal checkpoints, their exact schedules, and the complete training report pass independent compact review.

During development, collect all normal natural outcomes before scoring. An infrastructure/admission failure stops later owners; a natural non-goal counts as a functional failure. No retry in either case.
Do not generate, open, or run held-out 3120-3127 unless all 24 development cases are admitted, every augmented seed is at least 3/4, and a separate frozen held-out review returns GO.
No threshold, budget, sampler, checkpoint rule, seed, source, model, or topology changes are permitted after any numerical result.

planned_preserve: all v2 manifests, models, reports, and evidence

unresolved_risks: The 1,440-update anchor is principled by historical old-arm compute but remains one unsearched budget; failure does not show that every matched budget fails.

Terminal-only selection is required for matched selected budgets but differs from v2 earliest-minimum selection. The study estimates the complete v3 procedure and cannot isolate that selection change.
Equal total compute means each old-corpus row is presented 21 or 22 times and each augmented row 6 or 7 times. This is deliberate matched-compute exposure, not equal per-row weighting across arms.

Packing independent source fragments into one optimizer update changes gradient grouping relative to v2 tail windows. The rule is identical across arms, explicit, and part of the single budget-clock intervention, but its contribution cannot be separated.
Advice labels remain privileged, query-history-dependent, and not proved expert-correct or fully student-observable.
IDs 3130-3133 are roster-disjoint only at planning time; generated geometry, scientific initials, and payloads require future exact disjointness admission.
Simulator capability cannot qualify topology, biology, physical hardware, operator readiness, artwork integration, or R3 by itself.
